# `morphir tool install`

- **Usage:** `morphir tool install [FLAGS] <NAME>`

Install a local developer Morphir tool

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — Name of the tool to install

## Flags
- **`-v --version <VERSION>`** — Exact semantic version recorded for the local package
- **`--source <SOURCE>`** — Local unsigned package built for the current machine
- **`--channel <CHANNEL>`** — Acquisition channel; local sources require developer
